### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **10** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/plugin-approvals`, `@objectstack/downstream-contract`, `@objectstack/scenarios`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/service-datasource`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **81** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **7** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/lint/src/validate-null-guards.ts`, `packages/spec/liveness/action.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/object.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**39** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8d34c4404f951410083a6caebd6ad8003ea3423d`.

⛔ **11** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **7** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/lint/src/validate-null-guards.ts`, `packages/spec/liveness/action.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/object.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **13** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **69** of **252** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **191** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8d34c4404f951410083a6caebd6ad8003ea3423d` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `66509204cdb4bd6bcc55e2a41782fee20cae2a68` — the merge of head `a0d5b846e3d1a362b8d30ed26b47f909e96291d8` into base `8d34c4404f951410083a6caebd6ad8003ea3423d`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 66509204cdb4bd6bcc55e2a41782fee20cae2a68 && git checkout 66509204cdb4bd6bcc55e2a41782fee20cae2a68
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 8d34c4404f951410083a6caebd6ad8003ea3423d a0d5b846e3d1a362b8d30ed26b47f909e96291d8 && git checkout -B drift-repro 8d34c4404f951410083a6caebd6ad8003ea3423d && git merge --no-ff a0d5b846e3d1a362b8d30ed26b47f909e96291d8

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8d34c4404f951410083a6caebd6ad8003ea3423d
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 8d34c4404f951410083a6caebd6ad8003ea3423d` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `0ada605856a2bf5cdfaecd5fd9164c57cb8da4ef`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/conversions/entries/19/action-locations-acted-on.ts, packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts, packages/spec/src/data/object-action-layout.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/19.action-locations-page-parts-retired.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts.template, packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/studio/plugin.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/action-declarative-update.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts + the other 391 paths of the diff outside `content/docs/**` and `.changeset/**` (narrowing floor: `packages/**`, `ui/**`, `examples/**`, `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`, `sdui.manifest.json`), the readers read in full: ui/packages/types/src/ui-action.ts, ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionEngine.ts, ui/packages/core/src/actions/serverActionHandler.ts, ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx, ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/action-bar.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-quick-actions.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/relatedListActions.ts, ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx, ui/packages/layout/src/PageHeader.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RelatedRecordActionsBridge.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/DeclaredActionsBar.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewListRenderer.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/designModeHeaderPinsModel.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/ActionPreview.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/block-config.ts, packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-record-page-header.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-action-name-refs.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-object-action-layout.ts. Read outside the diff, not reviewed: packages/spec/src/conversions/apply.ts, packages/spec/src/conversions/stored.ts, packages/metadata-core/src/artifact-forward-conversion.ts, `.changeset/config.json`, `.changeset/pre.json`, `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`, `docs/qa/**`, and every reader above at the merge base `cb3f8b95`.

### ① Derived judgments

Inputs: card #36495 with its five comments, PR #37929 body and file list, the net diff `cb3f8b95...0ada6058` (420 files, +2322/−1631), and the 70 check-runs on the head (61 success, 9 skipped, 0 failed).

- **The tap.** It is on the card as comment 7213827153 (recorded 08:42Z, ruling letter A 「照卡上这套」 at 08:40Z on 2026-11-27), beside 7213534162 (start now, before 19.0.0 GA). It is the seat's record of the maintainer's tap, not a comment in the maintainer's own hand.
- **Enum equals the card's set: right.** `ACTION_LOCATIONS` at the head is exactly `list`, `record`, `record_page`, `record_row`, `record_related`, `record_section`. No extra word, none missing. `list_toolbar`, `list_item`, `record_header`, `record_more` are gone from the enum and each is refused by the enum's own error map with its replacement (`action.zod.ts`; pinned in `action.test.ts` and `retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts`).
- **Conversion table equals the card's: right.** `rewriteLocations` and `convertAction` implement the five card rows word for word. The component single-`location` mapping and the three TODO cases are additions the card does not state; they stay inside the ruling.
- **Accept set, narrowed: right.** Four values refused on `action.locations`, on the row `locations` of `action:button`, `action:icon` and group or menu members, and on the `location` of `record:quick_actions` and `action:group`. `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` is the right kind (narrowed over added).
- **Accept set, widened: declared wrong.** Four values are newly accepted at the same positions (`list`, `record`, `record_page`, `record_row`). See S2.
- **Public surface, `@object-ui/types`.** `ACTION_LOCATIONS` and `ActionLocation` change members (breaking); `actionFoldedIntoMenu` is a new export (widening); `arrangedHeaderActions` no longer writes `locations` (behaviour). `@object-ui/core` re-exports the same constant and type and `getActionsForLocation` takes the new type. Named in the changeset: right, except the Clause-② line (S2).
- **Published language packs.** `@object-ui/i18n` studio packs (en, zh) drop eight `…location.*` keys and add eight. Not named in the changeset as a key change (S2).
- **Readers.** `actionRendersAt` answers `record_page` and `record_row` for `record`: right. `isRecordScopedAction` (core) and `requiresRecord` (runtime) keep their exact sets, respelled: right; `record_related` stays outside core's set and `record_section` outside runtime's, as on main.

### ② Semver level

- `@objectstack/spec` major and `@object-ui/types` major are right. `.changeset/pre.json` is in `pre` mode (tag `next`), every package is at `19.0.0-next.1`, and all published packages sit in one `fixed` group, so the release stays on the 19 prerelease line.
- Every publishable package the diff touches is in the changeset (25 names; `@objectstack/dogfood` and `@objectstack/downstream-contract` are private). The ADR-0087 marker and the FROM → TO block are present; `Check Changeset` is green.
- The per-package levels below major are changelog placement only inside the fixed group. Two are loose (N5).
- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` is not true as written. See S2.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions` in the os-dev report (7227149591) is empty. Its six deviations are answered: (1) the skills split is carried by #37895, see N6; (2) class (c) size is the seat's call and `Check PR Size` is green; (3) `docs/qa` is not only prose, see N7; (4) the warming imports in 23 tests and (5) the `registry.ts.template` merge are fine; (6) majors confirmed in ②.
- `security_findings: none` agrees with the diff: no permission or capability gate changes; every gate comment that moved is a respelling.
- SQL push-down: the diff adds no query, id materialisation or in-app join. No finding.
- PR author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.

### ④ Design judgment

The narrowing itself holds: it is a respelling with a migration, not a capability taken away. A grep for each retired word over `packages/`, `ui/` and `examples/` at the head, outside migrations, conversions and CHANGELOG files, leaves only comments and the two pin tests. No consumer reads a retired word. Source is refused at parse with the replacement; stored rows (`applyConversionsToStoredItem`) and built artifacts (floor `19.0.0` opens the major step; floor at or below `18.6.0` opens it by `retiredAfter`) replay the conversion.

Break attempts that held, main readers against head readers:

- `record_header` + `list_item` to `record`: the header surfaces (`page:header` on the record page, side preview and phone bar, the design-mode pin rows, `MetadataTypeActions`) and the row surfaces (grid and list row menus, related-list rows in a parent, the inbox inline decisions) all go through `actionRendersAt` at the head. Same places.
- `record_related`: `record` does not cover it and need not. A `list_item` action already drew on related-list rows on main (`ROW_LOCATIONS_IN_RECORD`), and `record_header` + `record_related` becomes `record_page` + `record_related`, not `record`.
- `record_more`-only to `record_page` + `component: 'action:menu'`: main's header folded on `isMoreOnly` or on the component; the head folds on the component alone. Replacing an authored `component` is lossless: row menus, related lists, `DeclaredActionsBar` and `record:quick_actions` never read an object action's `component`, and the header reads only `action:menu`.
- `record_header` + `record_more` to `record_page` with no component: a button before and after.
- `arrangedHeaderActions`: pinned lifts the fold, unpinned sets it; same split as main's location rewrite.
- The three TODO cases are truly not expressible per item: the list toolbar reads the fold too; no word draws only folded actions; a group member has no `component`.

S1 (should-fix) — A fourth non-lossless case is converted silently. On main `record:quick_actions` at `record_header` (also its default location, and `PageHeader`'s `actions` prop) drew every action whose `locations` included `record_header`, whatever its `component` (`ActionEngine.getActionsForLocation` was a plain `includes`). At the head the bar at `record_page` leaves out every action with `component: 'action:menu'` (`record-quick-actions.tsx`). So an action authored `locations: ['record_header']` with `component: 'action:menu'` was a button in that bar on main and is absent from it at the head; no notice, no TODO. The cause is structural: main had two states (header word plus menu component: in the bar; `record_more`-only: not in the bar) and the head has one. The mirror case exists for an `action:bar` at `record_page` fed business actions: a former `record_more`-only action now appears in its overflow (no in-repo feeder passes business actions there). Census: zero authored `component: 'action:menu'` declarations in objectstack and in HotCRM. Fix either way: the conversion reports a TODO for an action that carries `record_header` and an authored `component: 'action:menu'`, or the changeset and the semantic entry name the exception and the maintainer accepts it, since the card says every action shows exactly where it shows today.

S2 (should-fix) — `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` under-declares. The diff also widens: four newly accepted enum values, the new `@object-ui/types` export `actionFoldedIntoMenu`, and eight new published `@object-ui/i18n` keys. House precedent on main declares a replacement with a registered conversion as `yes (narrowing)` (`.changeset/pre/37086-define-metadata-form-rename.md`, `.changeset/pre/37304-knowledge-source-governed-type.md`) and keeps `no (narrowing)` for pure retirements (`37712-agent-model-provider-retired.md`). The line belongs as `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` with the widened members named, in the changeset, the PR body and a corrected claim line. Prose faces only; no code moves, and the tier this review ran at already covers it.

N1 (nit) — At rest, two TODO shapes draw nothing on a 19 runtime until rewritten by hand: an action left as `['list_toolbar', 'record_more']` matches no reader, and a `record:quick_actions` left at `location: 'record_more'` finds no action. The read seam reports no TODO; only `os migrate meta` does. The changeset and the semantic entry say "left as stored" but not that consequence. Say it in the prose.

N2 (nit) — The toolbar TODO also fires when the action already carries `component: 'action:menu'`, where `['list', 'record_page']` with the component is lossless.

N3 (nit) — Studio's `record:quick_actions` dropdown now offers `record`. A bar at `record` reads the exact word: it draws only actions that declare `record`, not `record_page` ones, and does not apply the fold filter that `record_page` applies. Follow-up card.

N4 (nit) — Wording. The enum refusal on a block's `location: 'record_more'` prescribes `record_page`, which the conversion itself says is not equivalent. The `record_section` advice in `action.zod.ts` and `page.zod.ts` changed from "adds `record_more`" (the fold) to "adds `record_page`" (a header button unless the component is also set). The semantic entry's comment says two sites are left as stored; its text says three.

N5 (nit) — Changeset prose. "The packages listed as `patch` change comments, test fixtures or authoring copy only" is not true for `@objectstack/plugin-approvals` and `@objectstack/service-datasource` (shipped declarations) or `@object-ui/layout` (a runtime literal). `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/components` and `@object-ui/react` carry the breaking type through re-exports and parameters at minor or patch; moot in the fixed group.

N6 (nit) — Out of scope, `skills/**`: safe for this landing with one condition. After the merge, `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` (the locations table and the `actionLayout` paragraph), `rules/record-page.md:40`, `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md:139` and two eval files still teach refused words; the eval `must_contain` at `views-apps-actions-pages.json:30` requires `record_header`. Both skill gates are green on the head, so no checked example or served JSON fence carries one. `@objectstack/skills` is in the fixed group, so a `next` cut between this merge and #37895 PR 2 ships skills that teach words the same version refuses; the refusal names the replacement, so an agent recovers in one round. Condition: #37895 PR 2 lands before the next prerelease cut.

N7 (nit) — Out of scope, HotCRM and `docs/qa/**`. HotCRM is safe: it pins `@objectstack/spec` 18.6.0, its five `record_more` declarations are all convertible, and it has no TODO shape. `docs/qa` is not only prose: both recorded builds (`order_to_cash.json` as well as `travel_expense.json`) carry old words and declare `engines.protocol: ^19`, which the artifact door replays through the major step; but the checklist's scratch bodies sent to the save door (`studio-authoring.json:5372`, `records-forms.json:7273`) will now be refused, and the install-local recipe at `records-forms.json:77` carries no protocol floor (not verified whether it replays). No follow-up card is named for these; file one.

N8 (nit) — Body staleness. The PR body still says two derived gates are red until #37895 PR 1 lands; PR 1 (#37947) is on main and both gates are green on this head. The size line reads 417 files, +2308/−1624; the head is 420 files, +2322/−1631. The body names only `travel_expense.json` among the recorded builds.

Inputs — these and nothing else:

  · the check-runs on `0ada605856a2bf5cdfaecd5fd9164c57cb8da4ef`: their conclusions ARE the gate verdicts

Scope — the narrowing is declared of the whole PR, never of a path: the floor is EVERY path of the diff outside the
  prose faces (`content/docs/**`, `.changeset/**`), plus every file those hunks make a claim about, read in the cited code.
  Widen it freely, ⛔ never below that floor; the record's `Scope:` line lists both. No path is the lane seat's remainder.

   on the head already answered every derived gate family, and a local run costs more than it returns.
   If ONE probe is unavoidable, the record's `Local-runs:` line says `probe — REASON`; otherwise `none`.
   Scratch space is `/tmp/claude-0/-home-user/166e2125-4268-552f-a555-2b7c43a99f0f/scratchpad/pr-37929/` alone; nothing there you did not write this round is read.

Judge, in the record's own sections:
  ① Derived judgments — every accept-set and public-surface change the diff implies, each named right or wrong.
  ② Semver level — the changeset (or `skip-changeset`) matches what the diff publishes, and the `Clause-②:` line.
  ③ Boundary flags — every dev flag and every `open_questions` entry answered, or escalated.
     On every face, SQL push-down: a new id materialisation or in-app join where SQL could push down is a
     finding unless a reason is given (AGENTS.md, Prime Directive 5: SQL first).
  ④ Design judgment — the narrowing itself, read against the published spec on `main`: does it take a
     declared capability away at the consumer, or make the spec's own refusal real? A capability declared
     and not delivered is an implementation gap, implemented or retired, ⛔ never narrowed at the consumer.
     Read the spec and the cited code in the live tree, and try to break the design.
     Grade each finding must-fix, should-fix or nit — a nit has no effect on correctness or the contract.
     A must-fix is a FAIL; a must-fix or should-fix earns a delta review of its fix; nits alone end the round.
     Spell a must-fix or should-fix with its id and grade, `S1 (should-fix) — …`, and a clean round as
     `No must-fix, no should-fix.`: the queue guard reads a graded finding as OPEN on this head and
     refuses the record; the delta record names those it closes by id alone, `S1: closed`.
     A nit is fixed only on the prose faces, or left as an accepted deviation or a follow-up card: a fix
     anywhere else moves the head, and this record no longer covers it.
     ⛔ Judge the tree, never the PR body's account of it.
Sign `Implemented-by:` with the dev's branch and `Reviewed-by:` with your session id — the value is the FIRST
thing after each colon.

**L1 REWORK** at `0ada605856a2bf5cdfaecd5fd9164c57cb8da4ef` (L1-a for the seat). The isolated `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` record 7227370865 is a **PASS** (claim 7227191836; filled brief beside it). It has no must-fix, but it has two **should-fix** findings, and each owes a delta of its fix before ACCEPT. Everything else holds:
- the shipped enum is exactly the card's set, per the tap 「照卡上这套」 recorded at 7213827153;

- CI is 61 success, 9 skipped, 0 failed;

**Owed before ACCEPT.**
- **S1 (should-fix): a fourth case that is not lossless is converted silently.** On main, `record:quick_actions` at `record_header` drew every action whose `locations` included `record_header`, whatever its `component`. At the head, the bar at `record_page` drops every `component: 'action:menu'` action. So `locations: ['record_header']` with an authored `component: 'action:menu'` was a button in that bar and now is not, with no TODO. The census is zero in objectstack and HotCRM. Either fix closes it:
  - (a) the conversion reports a TODO for `record_header` plus an authored `component: 'action:menu'`, with a pin; or
  - (b) the changeset and the semantic entry name the exception, and the seat takes it to the maintainer, because the card promises that every action shows exactly where it shows today.

  (a) moves code and needs a new green head. (b) is prose plus a ruling.
- **S2 (should-fix): the `Clause-②:` line under-declares.** The diff also widens: four newly accepted values (`list`, `record`, `record_page`, `record_row`), the new `@object-ui/types` export `actionFoldedIntoMenu`, and eight new `@object-ui/i18n` keys. Main's precedent for a replacement with a registered conversion is `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` (`.changeset/pre/37086-…`, `.changeset/pre/37304-…`), with `no (narrowing)` reserved for pure retirements. Write it as `yes (narrowing)` with the widened members named, in the changeset, the PR body and a corrected claim line. This is a prose-only change.
